summary.text: Paige Reiring is the Mountain Party candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 79, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was nominated at the party's May 23, 2026 convention and faces incumbent Democrat Evan Hansen.

paragraphs.text: Reiring earned a bachelor's degree from The Ohio State University in 2016.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in Goshen, Ohio, held jobs including barista, gas station attendant and research writer, and later moved to West Virginia, where she has been involved in community projects in Morgantown and McDowell County.
Reiring said in the survey that she supports a moratorium on data centers in West Virginia and would not accept money from corporate donors or PACs.
She also named utility rates as a policy concern.
